claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Rivaroxaban is a selective factor Xa inhibitor with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen it is expected to be largely inactive, as its pharmacology requires coagulation cascade context absent in cell culture.
